Ethereum Treasuries Are Evolving 👀

As $BTC  continues to trade like a macro asset, major Ethereum holders are quietly changing their playbook.

BitMNR, the world’s largest Ethereum treasury firm, has officially entered ETH staking — a significant shift in how corporate treasuries manage long-term crypto holdings.

🔑 Key Highlights

• 74,880 $ETH staked
BitMNR deposited ~74,880 ETH into Ethereum’s proof-of-stake system, worth nearly $219M, per on-chain data from Arkham Intelligence.

• First-ever staking move
This marks the first time BitMNR has staked any ETH. Until now, the firm held its ETH purely for price appreciation.

• Massive ETH reserves
BitMNR holds approximately 4.06M ETH, valued at around $11.9B — about 3.37% of Ethereum’s total supply.

📊 Why This Matters

With current staking yields near 3.1%, staking its full ETH balance could generate ~126,000 ETH per year, representing hundreds of millions of dollars in potential annual yield at today’s prices.

📌 Bigger Picture

This move signals a strategic shift across the market:
Large holders are no longer relying solely on price appreciation. Ethereum is increasingly being treated as a yield-generating financial asset, not just a speculative investment.

Institutional ETH strategy is changing — and this may be just the beginning. 🚀

Why Institutions Accumulate Digital Assets Without Entering Web3

Many institutions hold digital assets without actively participating in Web3, and the reason is simple. They see crypto as a financial hedge, not a technology experiment.

In an environment shaped by persistent inflation, rising public debt, and currency dilution, scarce digital assets such as Bitcoin are increasingly viewed as protection against systemic risk. Crypto markets often respond faster and more globally to monetary easing than traditional safe havens, making them attractive from a macro perspective.

From a portfolio standpoint, even a modest allocation to crypto improves diversification. It lowers dependence on equities, bonds, and real estate while introducing asymmetric upside. Institutions value this convexity. Limited downside exposure with meaningful upside potential fits well within long-term balance sheet strategies.

Digital assets also represent an option on future financial infrastructure. If tokenization, on-chain settlement, or digital capital markets expand, early exposure becomes valuable. If growth slows, the position remains controlled. This optionality carries strategic value.

There is also a growing element of professional risk. With regulated ETFs, improved custody solutions, and clearer compliance standards, avoiding crypto entirely is becoming harder to justify. As infrastructure matures, non-participation itself becomes a risk.

On-chain data supports this view. Institutional capital continues to concentrate in $BTC  and $ETH  rather than speculative assets. The priority is capital preservation first, exposure second.

Institutions are not buying crypto because they fully believe in Web3.
They are buying because they are preparing for a more fragile global monetary system.

Avoid emotional traps to achieve stable profits

Trading cryptocurrencies may seem simple at first glance, but after a few years in the market, it becomes clear — to make money in the long term, it's not luck that counts, but anti-human execution.

First, don't let emotions dictate your orders. When the market surges, and there's a chorus of voices urging to buy, you must learn to restrain yourself; during a market crash, when panic spreads, you should calmly assess the opportunities. I've suffered losses myself: buying high and getting stuck, cutting losses on retracements, and the costs are very real.

Second, never go all in at once; having a full position is essentially gambling your wealth. Once your position is too heavy, your mindset will be disturbed, and your judgment will become distorted. The market doesn't lack opportunities; what it lacks is whether you still have ammunition left.

Third, if the direction is unclear, do nothing. A high-level consolidation might be a false breakout; a low-level fluctuation might continue to plunge. Guessing the direction is the most common mistake retail investors make; wait for the trend to reveal itself.

Fourth, buy during a significant drop and sell during a significant rise. When a large bearish candle appears on the daily chart, consider accumulating in batches; when a large bullish candle appears, learn to take profits appropriately. This rhythm seems simple but is highly practical.

Fifth, look at the speed of decline, not just the magnitude of decline; a slow decline often lacks the strength to rebound; a rapid decline, on the other hand, is more likely to see a quick rebound. Changes in speed are more important than price levels.

Sixth, building a position should be like paving a road, not jumping off a cliff. Gradually build from the bottom; the more it drops, the more you buy, using time and rhythm to gain a cost advantage, rather than betting on a single point.

Seventh, consolidation is not the answer; breakthroughs are. After significant increases, there will be consolidations, and after significant decreases, there will also be consolidations. Don't clear your position all at once in a consolidation, nor should you bottom-fish all at once; wait for the direction to be chosen before adjusting your position accordingly.

Final words
Trading cryptocurrencies ultimately comes down to competing with yourself.
These concepts aren't complicated; the challenge lies in long-term execution.
Don't pursue overnight wealth; instead, aim for stable, replicable profits to truly survive in this market. #BTC #ETH

避开情绪陷阱，才能走向稳定盈利

炒币这件事，入门看着简单，真在市场里走几年才明白——想长期赚钱，靠的不是运气，而是反人性的执行力。

第一，别让情绪替你下单，行情猛涨，满屏都是追多的声音，你要学会克制；行情暴跌，恐慌蔓延的时候，反而要冷静评估机会。我自己也吃过亏：追高被套、回调割肉，代价都很真实。

第二，永远不要一次性梭哈，满仓，本质就是赌身家。一旦仓位过重，心态必乱，判断也会随之失真。市场不缺机会，缺的是你手里还有没有子弹。

第三，方向不清楚，就什么都别做，高位横盘，可能是假突破；低位震荡，也可能继续下杀。猜方向，是散户最容易犯的错，等走势自己走出来。

第四，大跌敢买，大涨敢卖，日线级别的大阴线，可以考虑分批吸筹；大阳线出现时，学会适当兑现利润。这个节奏，看似简单，却非常实用。

第五，看跌速，而不是只看跌幅，阴跌往往反弹乏力；加速下跌，反而容易出现快速反抽。
速度的变化，比点位更重要。

第六，建仓要像铺路，不是跳崖，从底部慢慢铺，跌得多，买得多，用时间和节奏去换成本优势，而不是赌一个点。

第七，横盘不是答案，突破才是，涨多了会横，跌多了也会横。别在横盘里一把清仓，也别一把抄底，等方向选择后，再顺势调整仓位。

最后一句
炒币，说到底是和自己较劲。
这些东西都不复杂，难的是长期执行。
不追求一夜暴富，只追求稳定、可复制的盈利，你才能真正在这个市场里活下来。#BTC #ETH

🔥Ethereum Treasury Giant BitMNR Stakes $219M in $ETH  for the First Time

As $BTC continues to trade as a macro asset, large Ethereum holders are quietly shifting strategy. BitMNR, the world's largest Ethereum treasury firm, has officially entered ETH staking - marking a major change in how corporate treasuries manage long-term crypto holdings.

Key Points:

BitMNR deposited around 74,880 $ETH into Ethereum's proof-of-stake system, worth nearly $219 million, according to on-chain data shared by Arkham Intelligence.

This is the first time the firm has staked any of its Ethereum. Until now, BitMNR kept its massive ETH reserves untouched, relying purely on price appreciation.

On-chain data shows BitMNR holds about 4.06 million ETH, valued near $11.9 billion roughly 3.37% of Ethereum's total supply.

With current staking yields around 3.1%, staking its full balance could generate over 126,000 ETH annually, translating into hundreds of millions in potential yield at current prices. The move signals a broader shift: large holders are no longer just betting on price. They're starting to treat Ethereum as a yield-generating financial asset - not just a speculative one.

title: 当 Coinbase 与 a16z 看向 2026，我更关注这些信号
subTitle:
最近，Coinbase 与 a16z 等一线机构纷纷给出了对 2026 年的预测。
在一级市场投资中，我们通常会结合这些机构的投资方向，从真实需求、历史痛点、产品演进路径，以及潜在赛道的逻辑推演等角度，判断一个项目是否值得投入。

先说两点前提：

1 当预测具像化时，必然失真
我们能较为确定的不是具体结果，而是：
一段时间后，哪些项目的成功与失败，会反推出潜在需求真正在哪里。
北美机构对政策、监管与宏观经济的敏感度，依然值得高度重视。
2 创新不可预测，拥挤与黑马并存
被广泛看好的方向，往往意味着更多资源与关注，但也更容易变得拥挤。
真正的黑马，常常出现在意料之外，却又在情理之中——
这两点需要同时被纳入观察框架。

部分赛道分析如下：

👉从 RWA 到直接受益赛道

Coinbase 明确关注证券型 RWA（如股票）。今年 Ondo 等项目已经做出尝试，算是开了个头。
逻辑并不复杂：
• 美股是一个极大的市场
• 加密市场目前仍然偏小
• 那加密的优势在哪里？
在衍生品设计、全球化交易、以及7×24 小时的运行能力。
顺着这个逻辑自然会引出一系列问题：
• 谁来承接并接入这些资产？
• 在哪里交易？股票 perp 是否会重塑衍生品格局？
• 哪些基础设施能进入真实应用场景？
• 哪条链是监管认可、市场信任的？
• 预言机、借贷、清算如何协同？

👉链上银行赛道

加密体系对“类银行业务”的降本增效冲击非常直接。
稳定币的发展，事实上已经在分流传统银行职能，而 SWIFT 在效率层面并无优势。
如果顺着逻辑推演银行如何入局：
基础设施 → 稳定币 → 支付 → 链上理财 → 金融衍生品服务
这条路径本身是高度顺滑的，实现静待条件成熟非一蹴而就。

👉隐私，是必须攻克的一环

这里的“隐私”，并不是“天地不知、你知我知”。
而是：
 对监管透明、对市场不透明的隐私逻辑。
至少在 KYC / 合规端可验证，在交易细节上具备保护能力。
因此，ZK / FHE 不再是理想主义，而是合规交易的必要条件。

👉AI Agent 经济体开始成形

这不只是“AI + Crypto”的概念，
而是：
• Crypto 成为 AI Agent 的结算层
• x402 推动链上微支付（可能非短期，但方向明确）
• AI Agent 之间开始产生真实交易
• 部分 Agent 将承担交易、风控、合规等职能
...
机构更多从“效率提升”角度看 AI，
而我更关注：AI 本身正在成为链上的经济主体。

👉L2：应用链将跑赢通用链，或不断分离

过去一两年，成功应用往往在通用链（如 ETH）起家，
随后为了降本增效与效率优化，启动自己的应用链，已经成为一条被验证的路径。
以太坊选择了阵痛式转型，定位为安全保障与 DA 层。
#Fusaka 升级之后，可用性显著提升。
ETH并非没有竞争者，
但其优势在于：最成熟的开发者生态 + 足够长时间的安全性证明。

👉火热的预测市场赛道

选举与世界杯，会把大量圈外用户带入预测市场。
这个赛道具备：
• 盈利能力强
• 商业逻辑清晰
• 但模型仍然相对单一
我个人更关注的是：细分市场的机会与预测市场聚合器。
当市场足够碎片化，最终决定胜负的，将是体验、分发能力与流动性整合。

👉稳定币与支付

真实需求非常清晰：
• 跨境汇款
• 务工群体
• 高通胀国家保值需求
还记得哈耶克的《货币非国家化》吗？
链上稳定币，正在凿穿那些汇率脆弱国家的护城河。
本质上，这是美元影响力的延伸。

正如开头所说，预测只能给出模糊方向。
当流动性充足时，加密原生的极客式创新依然不可忽视，
这也是具备研究能力的投资人，最重要的α来源。
先写到这里，后面再持续补充与更新。

Why Q1 2026 Could Set the Tone for Bitcoin and Altcoins 📈

In the previous cycle, Bitcoin ($BTC ) dropped sharply from the $69,000 region to nearly $32,000 before the real structure began to change. The turning point came when price reclaimed the 50-week EMA around $48,000. That reclaim didn’t trigger instant euphoria — instead, it marked the transition from survival to accumulation.

Fast forward to today, and the same 50-week EMA sits much higher, near the $98,000 zone. If Bitcoin repeats a similar structural move in early 2026, a push toward the $100k–$102k region becomes a realistic technical outcome. That would represent a controlled expansion, not a blow-off top — and historically, those are the moves that matter most.

What’s often overlooked is what this kind of Bitcoin behavior does to the rest of the market. A 15–20% BTC expansion has repeatedly translated into 30–40% upside in Ethereum and other large-cap assets. Smaller altcoins tend to move even faster, sometimes posting 60–80% runs before momentum cools. This doesn’t mean a full bull market starts immediately — it means liquidity rotates.

Q1 also carries a structural advantage. January is when institutions redeploy fresh capital. Hedge funds, asset managers, and large allocators reset positioning. At the same time, traditional markets like gold, equities, and indices are already near highs, while crypto still sits below its peak. To institutions, that relative undervaluation matters.

Add in the seasonal effect of December tax-loss selling flipping into January re-entry, and selling pressure often disappears just as demand returns. When this shift happens collectively, price reacts fast — especially in a market as small as crypto.

This isn’t about hype. It’s about structure, liquidity, and timing. And those forces quietly favor Q1 2026.

🔥 FOMC Dot Plot: The Secret Market Alpha
Most traders obsess over Fed rate decisions, but the real insight lies in the Dot Plot — a chart that only drops four times a year (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec).
Each dot is a Fed member’s guess for year-end rates.
Dots higher → hawkish: rates stay high, Gold, Silver, Crypto, Stocks may pause
Dots lower → dovish: rate cuts likely, risk assets surge 🚀
It’s not about today’s Fed move — it’s about their sentiment for 2026 and beyond. Smart traders watch the clusters, position ahead of the herd, and turn subtle signals into real alpha.

title: If you’re holding altcoins like XRP, ETH, or SOL, the next phase could be important.
subTitle:
Early 2026 has the potential to change the tone of the market — not because of hype, but because this is usually when new money starts entering. Big investors close their books at the end of the year, reset positions, and slowly move back into risk assets once the new year begins.
Traditional markets have already run quite a bit. Gold is near the top, stocks are strong, and many assets look pricey.
Crypto is different.
Bitcoin and most altcoins are still below previous highs, which makes the space more attractive to large investors who are hunting for upside. And because crypto is still a relatively small market, even modest institutional buying can push prices faster than people expect.
The weakness you see at the end of the year is often just temporary. A lot of traders sell in December for tax reasons or portfolio balancing — not because they’re scared. When January arrives, that pressure usually fades, and money quietly returns.
A key area to watch is Bitcoin’s long-term trend zone. In past cycles, once BTC broke back above it, momentum followed. Right now, that zone sits around the low–mid $90K range. If Bitcoin can stay above that level in early 2026, a move toward the high 90s or even low 100s isn’t impossible.
Whenever Bitcoin jumps 15–20%, altcoins usually react harder. $ETH and the bigger names tend to outperform, while smaller coins can move very quickly.
That doesn’t mean the market will go straight up. Rallies often pull people in… and then test their patience again.
My plan stays simple: stay calm, hold spot positions, and focus on solid projects like $SOL , $XRP ,#ETH

title: Что такое dApp-приложение
subTitle:
dApp (Decentralized Application) — это децентрализованное приложение, которое работает на базе блокчейна и смарт-контрактов, а не на централизованных серверах одной компании.
В отличие от классических приложений (Web2), dApp не имеет единого владельца или точки контроля: логика, данные и транзакции распределены между узлами блокчейн-сети.
Ключевые характеристики dApp
1. Децентрализация
Бизнес-логика хранится в смарт-контрактах
Контракты развернуты в блокчейне (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana и др.)
Нет центрального сервера или администратора, который может изменить правила в одностороннем порядке
2. Прозрачность и проверяемость
Код смарт-контрактов, как правило, открыт
Все операции записываются в блокчейн
Любой пользователь может проверить транзакции и логику работы
3. Отсутствие посредников
Пользователь взаимодействует напрямую с протоколом
Нет банков, платёжных систем или централизованных операторов
Расчёты происходят peer-to-peer
4. Self-custody
Пользователь сам владеет активами
dApp не хранит средства клиентов
Доступ осуществляется через Web3-кошелёк (MetaMask, OKX Wallet, Trust Wallet и др.)
Как работает dApp (упрощённо)
Пользователь заходит в интерфейс (Web или Mobile)
Подключает Web3-кошелёк
Подписывает транзакцию своим приватным ключом
Смарт-контракт выполняет действие в блокчейне
Результат фиксируется в распределённом реестре
Важно: даже если интерфейс dApp отключится, смарт-контракты продолжают существовать в блокчейне.

Web-интерфейс (React, Vue и др.)
Smart Contracts

title: Is Ethereum About to End 2025 in the Red — And Does the Market Underestimate the Risk?
subTitle:
For a network often described as the backbone of Web3, Ethereum is facing an uncomfortable reality: 2025 may close as one of its weakest years on record. As of now, ETH is down approximately 13.92% over the past 365 days, and if December closes in negative territory, Ethereum would officially mark one of its most disappointing annual performances — comparable to the deep bear market of 2018.
What makes the situation more striking is the timing. Ethereum has less than 96 hours left to reverse course and avoid finishing the year in the red. Whether it succeeds or fails may shape market sentiment heading into 2026.
At the time of writing, ETH is trading near $2,930, down over 1% in the last 24 hours. Trading volume has dropped sharply by 27.6% to $12.19 billion, a clear signal that traders are stepping back rather than aggressively positioning. Since mid-December, Ethereum has repeatedly failed to reclaim the psychologically important $3,000 level, despite having traded above $4,000 in August and carrying widespread expectations of a move toward $5,000 earlier in the year.
This loss of momentum highlights a growing disconnect between long-term narratives and short-term market reality.
Selling Pressure and Shifting Convictions
Downside pressure intensified after on-chain data revealed that a wallet believed to be associated with Erik Voorhees sold more than $13 million worth of ETH. While individual transactions do not define market trends, such moves tend to weigh on sentiment, especially during periods of low liquidity and declining volume.
Adding to the narrative shift, Samson Mow, CEO of JAN3 and a long-time Bitcoin advocate, publicly confirmed that he has fully exited Ethereum positions to focus exclusively on Bitcoin. Although this reflects a personal investment philosophy rather than a market-wide signal, high-profile exits often reinforce broader doubts during periods of underperformance.
Together, these developments have fueled debate within the crypto community: is Ethereum merely consolidating after years of dominance, or is it losing capital rotation to competing narratives?
A Year of Structural Weakness, Not Capitulation
Despite the negative annual performance, Ethereum’s price action does not resemble panic-driven capitulation. Instead, 2025 has been characterized by persistent underperformance, fading momentum, and declining speculative interest, rather than sharp sell-offs.
ETH’s inability to hold above $3,000 reflects structural hesitation rather than aggressive bearish conviction. Lower volume confirms that many participants are choosing to wait rather than exit entirely — a behavior often seen near transitional phases of the market cycle.
From a historical perspective, years like 2018 demonstrate that extended periods of weakness can coexist with long-term network growth. However, markets tend to price narratives long before fundamentals reassert themselves.
Looking Toward 2026
Despite a challenging 2025, a significant portion of the Ethereum community remains cautiously optimistic about 2026. Expectations center on renewed liquidity, evolving Layer 2 adoption, broader tokenization initiatives, and a potential shift in macro conditions that could benefit risk assets.
Still, optimism alone may not be enough. Ethereum’s ability to regain investor confidence will likely depend on whether price can reclaim key psychological levels and whether capital flows return with conviction — not just hope.
For now, Ethereum stands at a crossroads: either the current weakness becomes a prolonged phase of stagnation, or it forms the base for a renewed cycle in the year ahead.

title: 比特币估值系列（一）
subTitle:
比特币最核心的应用是储值，它的未来目标就是成为人们的储值首选。
那么，在比特币出现之前，我们都用什么东西储值呢？也就是说，
我们赚了一笔钱，除去消费余下的部分，我们会以什么形式来保
存财富呢？它们主要是黄金、货币和不动产。
全球黄金的总市值是 7.7 万亿美元，广义货币总量是 90.4 万亿美元，不动产是 217 万亿美元。（7.7万亿是2018年的数据了，实际到今天黄金的总市值已经是30万亿美金了）
 黄金现在的主要用途就是储值，而论储值，比特币各方面都强于黄金，市值超越黄金只是时间问题。
 广义的货币包含：现金、定活期存款、证券公司客户保证金等。除了现金（占比 8%）用于流通，其余部分都是用于储值。
 不动产主要用途应该还是居住和使用，但是肯定也有相当大的比例是用于储值的。如果不是因为比特币，我应该也会把我的大部分资金用于买房子。由于没有比例可以查，我们暂时假设 20%比例的不动产是用于储值的（这个比例不影响最终结果的数量级）。
那么，全球总储值市场有多大呢？ 7.7 + 90.4 × 92% + 217 × 20% = 134 万亿。
而比特币总量只有 2100 万，大约有 300 万永久丢失。考虑到比特币储值相对于黄金、货币和不动产的绝对优势，每个比特币将涨到 750 万美元，折合 5000 万人民币。
这就完了？当然没有。
单纯按黄金的总市值套的话：
30/7.7=3.8倍，5000×3.8=19000人民币一个。所以一定要定投比特币。
每年还有通货膨胀了……
未完待续。（摘下九神_囤比特币）

Analysts Target $5,000 Ethereum as BitMine Stakes $219 Million Worth of ETH
A leading DeFi market analyst has released a new outlook on Ethereum (ETH), projecting a potential move toward the $5,000 level in the next major phase of the cycle. If realized, such a move would not only mark a significant technical milestone for ETH, but could also act as a catalyst for broader momentum across the crypto market.
At the same time, BitMine, one of the world’s largest Ethereum treasury management firms, has begun actively staking a substantial portion of its ETH holdings. The company recently deployed approximately $219 million worth of ETH into Ethereum’s Proof-of-Stake system, reinforcing long-term confidence in the network and signaling a strategic shift toward yield optimization.
Ethereum Price Outlook: A Controlled Correction, Not a Breakdown
According to analyst Pepesso, Ethereum continues to trade within a clearly defined descending channel on the 2-day chart, a structure that has persisted for several months. Throughout this period, ETH has consistently formed lower highs and lower lows, yet without showing signs of panic selling or structural collapse.
Instead, price action suggests a controlled correction, often associated with institutional rebalancing and gradual accumulation rather than distribution. This type of market behavior is commonly observed when smart money transitions from selling pressure into long-term positioning.
Currently, ETH is holding a major demand zone between $2,800 and $3,000, an area that has repeatedly absorbed downside volatility. Each test of this zone has been met with increasingly aggressive buy responses, indicating that selling pressure is weakening over time.
Volatility has also continued to compress. Candlestick ranges are narrowing, and price remains constrained within the descending channel. Historically, such compression often precedes high-magnitude directional moves, as market participants build positions ahead of a breakout.
From a momentum perspective, bearish continuation attempts near the lower boundary of the channel have consistently failed. Despite multiple tests, sellers have been unable to force a decisive breakdown. Repeated rejection of lower prices typically reflects growing underlying demand.
If ETH successfully breaks above the descending channel and sustains bullish follow-through, market structure would shift rapidly from corrective to trend continuation. Under that scenario, the $5,000 level emerges as the next major technical and psychological target.
Overall, the current phase appears less like weakness and more like preparation for a significant expansion in price.
BitMine Begins Staking $219 Million in ETH
While price consolidates, on-chain activity shows long-term conviction strengthening.
BitMine has officially launched Ethereum staking operations, transferring nearly $219 million worth of ETH into Ethereum’s Proof-of-Stake infrastructure. On-chain data from Arkham confirms that multiple wallets linked to BitMine sent large transactions to the BatchDeposit contract, totaling approximately 74,880 ETH.
This deposit method is commonly used by institutional participants to aggregate funds before deploying validator nodes at scale.
On-chain analyst EmberCN noted that this marks BitMine’s first major step into active ETH staking, aimed at optimizing yield on its treasury assets rather than holding ETH passively.
BitMine currently holds approximately 4.066 million ETH, with an estimated annual staking yield of 3.12%. If fully deployed, this could generate roughly 126,800 ETH per year, equivalent to around $371 million annually at current prices near $2,927 per ETH.
Notably, BitMine’s ETH treasury recently surpassed 4 million tokens for the first time, following an additional $40 million ETH purchase. Over the past week alone, the company added nearly 100,000 ETH, with an average acquisition price close to $2,991.
In November, BitMine announced plans to roll out Ethereum staking in Q1 2026, leveraging its internal infrastructure known as the Made-in-America Validator Network (MAVAN). The company has selected three institutional staking providers for initial testing and plans to scale gradually after evaluating performance, security, and operational stability.
Final Thoughts
Ethereum’s current market structure, combined with increasing institutional staking activity, suggests a market in consolidation rather than decline. While price remains compressed within a corrective channel, underlying fundamentals and on-chain behavior point to long-term confidence.
If technical resistance gives way and momentum shifts decisively, the $5,000 ETH target could become a realistic reference point for the next phase of the cycle.

Eight years ago, I entered the market with over ten thousand in my pocket, feeling anxious about every rise and fall, and getting cut when there was a shake. Back then, I thought hard work could win, but later I realized:

Making money relies on dodging, getting rich relies on patience, turning things around relies on waiting.

What truly changes social class is never the daily ups and downs, but rather waiting for one or two big opportunities that directly elevate you.

I remember once chasing a favorable trend and having considerable unrealized gains. But that night, I cleared everything. Many asked, "Aren't you waiting for a higher open tomorrow?" I said no.

Because I know: when good news lands, that's the peak; hesitation marks the beginning of risk.

Over the years, I've become increasingly cautious, not heavily invested before holidays, staying out before major events, and resting when I don't understand. Some laugh at my caution, but it's this very caution that allows me to survive and wait for major market movements.

In the crypto world, the greatest test is not the technology, but the mindset. Prices haven't moved yet, but emotions have already collapsed. But seasoned traders only consider right and wrong, not emotions.

You ask me how to go from ten thousand to one hundred thousand?

It's about practicing to dare to stay out, being able to wait, and executing steadily.

When you can achieve this, you'll find that money doesn't chase after you; it's when the market comes that you have chips in hand and confidence in your heart.

content:
Landmark Crypto Bills Drive a 2025 Regulatory Shift in the U.S.

U.S. crypto regulation reached a turning point in 2025 as Congress advanced from enforcement-led oversight toward clearer statutory frameworks for digital assets. Lawmakers delivered definitive rules for stablecoins and made meaningful progress on broader market structure, signaling a long-term commitment to regulated digital finance.

The most significant development was the passage of the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins (GENIUS) Act, signed into law in July 2025. As the first comprehensive federal crypto statute, the GENIUS Act removed payment stablecoins from securities and commodities law and placed oversight under banking regulators rather than the SEC or CFTC.

Under the law, stablecoin issuers must fully back tokens with cash or short-term U.S. Treasuries, are prohibited from offering yield, and must comply with Bank Secrecy Act requirements. A tiered framework allows state-level regulation for issuers below $10 billion in market capitalization, while larger issuers fall under federal supervision. From a policy standpoint, the act reflects U.S. support for regulated private stablecoins as the preferred digital dollar instrument, reducing near-term momentum for a retail central bank digital currency (CBDC).

Beyond stablecoins, Congress advanced but did not finalize a comprehensive crypto market structure regime. The House passed the Digital Asset Market Clarity (CLARITY) Act, which proposes criteria for distinguishing digital commodities from securities and introduces a “blockchain maturity” pathway for decentralized networks to transition out of securities regulation.

Taken together, these measures marked a clear shift in regulatory tone. In 2025, Congress provided long-sought clarity in critical areas while leaving final market structure rules as the next major catalyst for U.S. crypto policy.

title: Crypto ETFs in 2025: When Wall Street Truly Stepped Inside Digital Assets
subTitle:
2025 quietly became a turning point for crypto’s relationship with traditional finance. While price headlines grabbed attention, the deeper shift happened through exchange-traded funds. Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs did not just survive their first full year in the market—they matured, absorbed volatility, and proved that institutional capital now treats crypto as a serious asset class rather than an experiment.

Bitcoin ETFs continued to dominate the narrative. Since their historic launch in January 2024, spot Bitcoin ETFs accumulated $57.7 billion in net inflows by December 15, 2025, marking a 59% increase from roughly $36.2 billion at the start of the year. These numbers tell a clear story: demand remained strong, but it was not smooth or emotional. Capital moved in waves, reacting to price and macro conditions instead of hype.
At the peak of optimism, investor appetite surged. On October 6, when Bitcoin pushed toward an all-time high above $126,000, ETFs absorbed $1.2 billion in a single day. That moment reflected confidence and momentum. But when Bitcoin later slipped below $90,000 on November 11, investors quickly pulled back, withdrawing $900 million within weeks. Earlier in the year, February delivered the harshest stress test, when fears tied to trade and inflation drove $1 billion in ETF outflows, still the worst day on record for Bitcoin ETFs.
Ethereum followed a different but equally important path. After spot Ethereum ETFs debuted in July, they generated $12.6 billion in net inflows by mid-December. When ETH rallied toward nearly $4,950 in August, the products saw $1 billion flow in during a single day, proving that Ethereum had secured its own institutional lane rather than riding Bitcoin’s shadow.
Beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum, access expanded. Regulatory changes introduced generic listing standards, removing the need for case-by-case decisions on whether a digital asset qualified as a commodity. This opened the door to ETF products tracking assets like XRP, Solana, and diversified crypto baskets, shifting the conversation from “if” crypto belongs on Wall Street to “how broadly” it should be represented.
What stands out most is not just the scale of capital, but its behavior. ETF investors acted with discipline—buying strength, cutting exposure during stress, and reallocating rather than exiting crypto entirely. These products increasingly operated in the background, quietly reshaping market structure while attention stayed fixed on price.
By the end of 2025, crypto ETFs were no longer an experiment. They had become infrastructure—linking digital assets to global capital with rules, liquidity, and restraint. That structural change may outlast any single bull or bear cycle.

Bitmine Enters Ethereum Staking: Is This a Good Bet or Just Following a Trend?

Recently, a notable development in the on-chain space is that Bitmine (BMN) announced an investment of nearly $451 million into Ethereum staking. This action, in the current environment, is enough to spark various interpretations from market participants.

First, let's look at the most straightforward data: $451 million allocated to the ETH staking pool is no small amount. It at least indicates two things: first, that large mining/power players are starting to seriously consider and participate in the proof-of-stake system, and second, a certain recognition of Ethereum's future returns and liquidity model. Compared to traditional mining output, this is a more 'passive income' strategy and also signals a long-term holding of assets.

But it’s worth asking – is this truly a bullish bet on Ethereum's long-term value, or is it a cross-asset income optimization strategy? After all, in the context of unstable Bitcoin mining returns and rising costs, redirecting some funds towards ETH staking is a natural choice for many large participants after weighing the risk and return.

From a market perspective, such capital deployment is not a small move; it could have a chain reaction effect on staking rates, liquidity, and the overall Ethereum ecosystem. A higher staking ratio means that tradeable ETH becomes scarcer, which at least won't be a negative signal from a supply-demand standpoint.

However, let's not romanticize this operation too much. Staking strategies are essentially bets on future returns, relying on market stability and long-term user participation. In other words, even if the data looks good, it doesn’t mean prices will skyrocket tomorrow.

Overall, this large-scale staking seems more like a structural adjustment of internal industry forces rather than an amplification of short-term sentiment. For ordinary participants, understanding the logic behind this is more important than simply chasing trends. #加密市场观察 #ETH $ETH

先说最直观的数据：4.51 亿美元放到 ETH 质押池，这是一个不小的数目。它至少说明两点：一是大型矿业/算力玩家开始认真看待并参与权益证明体系，二是对以太坊未来收益和流动性模型的某种认可。相比传统算力产出，这是一种更“被动收益”的策略，也是对资产长期持有的一种信号。

毕竟在比特币挖矿收益不稳定、成本上升的背景下，把部分资金转向 ETH 质押，是很多大型参与者在权衡收益风险之后的自然选择。

Mainland Web3 practitioners have a significant pain point, which stems from the traditional accumulation of concepts. Most Chinese Web3 practitioners, whether in the country or abroad, share this pain point.

Producing value is value itself, rather than capturing service value. This viewpoint is deeply rooted. I remember chatting with a British person who asked me a question: "Your country provides more than 30% of goods and services for 7 billion people globally, so why are you still alleviating poverty?" I responded with a heartfelt reply that from a realist and traditional logic perspective, we believe in the prosperity of the nation through industry and labor creating value.

The statement that industry prospers the nation and labor creates value does not hold in a highly industrialized national economy. If this statement were true, the Soviet Union would not have disbanded. In the last century, the Soviet Union had an extremely powerful industrial capability and was a model of industrial prosperity. It could produce the world's strongest tanks, the deepest drillings, and the fastest interceptors. However, in terms of economic systems, the Soviet Union's highly centralized planned economy led to a complete disconnection between production and value distribution.

Even during the dissolution of the Soviet Union, the industrial legacy of the Soviet Union, based on surface data, appeared to be far greater than the total global industrial output at that time. Such a super empire collapsed overnight, and history didn’t even give it a chance for reflection.

Those who continue to hold onto the Soviet legacy are even more absurd, focusing on removing oligarchs rather than reflecting on policies. From the perspective of Russia and Ukraine, it is an imperial tragedy.

The Long Ride in ETH is Over, This ETH Whale Finally Lets Go.
Markets don’t always forgive, but they do give second chances.
After months of watching, waiting, and slowly trimming, it’s done. The $ETH whale who built that big position around the $2,545 zone has finally closed the book… and honestly, you can almost feel the exhale.
Over the last 12 hours, the wallet unloaded its final 10,002 ETH, cashing out roughly $29.4 million in one last move. With that, the entire cycle that started back in mid-December comes to an end.

Sometimes the win isn’t a clean comeback. Sometimes it’s just surviving long enough to stand back up.

title: 🔥 Ethereum Roadmap Update — “Hegota” Upgrade Late 2026 Me Expected
subTitle:
Ethereum developers ne officially confirm kar diya hai ke network ka next-to-next major upgrade “Hegota” hoga, jo late 2026 ke liye plan kiya ja raha hai.
Ye upgrade “Glamsterdam” ke baad aayega, jo pehle half of 2026 me roll out hone ki expectation hai.
🧠 Kya Decide Hua Hai?
Ethereum devs ne:
Upgrade ka naam fix kar diya: Hegota
Rough timeline clear kar di: 2026 (second half)
Aur ye signal diya ke ab upgrades zyada frequently aayein ge
Ye approach thodi different hai compared to pehle, jahan ek saal me sirf ek bada upgrade aata tha.
⚙️ Faster Development, Faster Shipping
Is change ka reason simple hai: Ethereum ecosystem bohot fast grow kar raha hai, aur developers nahi chahte ke protocol upgrades slow ho jaayein.
Earlier is saal community se feedback aaya tha ke:
Network demand fast hai
Lekin protocol changes utni speed se ship nahi ho rahe
Isi liye devs ne roadmap ko accelerate karne ka decision liya.
🛠️ Hegota Me Kya Aaa Sakta Hai?
Abhi officially koi EIP announce nahi hua, kyun ke:
Glamsterdam ka final scope January meeting me decide hoga
Hegota ke features par serious discussion February ke baad start hogi
Lekin ek strong candidate already discuss ho raha hai 👇
🌳 Verkle Trees — Big Possibility
Developers Verkle Trees par focus kar rahe hain:
Ye ek new data structure hai
Nodes ko data zyada efficiently store & verify karne me help karta hai
Hardware requirements kam ho sakti hain
👉 Iska direct benefit:
More decentralization, kyun ke zyada log easily nodes chala sakenge.
🏷️ “Hegota” Naam Ka Matlab
Ethereum ka tradition hai ke upgrade names:
Ek Devcon host city
Aur ek star name se mil kar bante hain
“Hegota” =
Bogota (execution layer reference)
Heze (consensus layer reference)
🧩 Big Picture
Fusaka me PeerDAS aaya,
Glamsterdam me Block-level Access Lists aur enshrined PBS expected hain,
Aur ab devs already Hegota ki planning start kar chuke hain.
Ye clearly show karta hai ke Ethereum development slow nahi ho raha, balki aur structured ho raha hai.

消息面在说什么？

那篇10x Research的文章，看起来挺唬人，但核心就几点：市场现在很“分裂”，表面安静，底下却波涛汹涌。对于ETH，它说趋势目前还是看跌，但距离反转只差5%​ 的涨幅！它给的短期生死线是2991美元，站稳这里，趋势就可能翻多。

技术面看到了什么？

再看咱们这张4小时图，趋势线是向上的，MACD在零轴上方金叉，这都是好迹象，说明多头还有力气。但现在价格正卡在中间，上有3150的强压顶门，下有2970的关键位和2780的强支撑托底。这就好比爬山爬到半山腰，上是悬崖，下是缓坡。

现在玩家该怎么办？
别光看热闹，手里有币或者想跟上的，记住绮禾这句话：“关键位附近不做单，方向明确再动手”。
如果你空仓：别急！最好的策略是等。等行情在2970附近表现出明显的支撑，再考虑轻仓介入。目标先看3100，再看3150。
如果你有仓位：以2970作为你短线的防守线。只要不破，可以拿着看看。如果仓位重，接近3150压力位时，可以考虑减掉一部分，落袋为安。跌破2970且无反抽，就要果断止损或减仓，保护本金。

绮禾的个人观点：
今晚，我觉得直接暴力拉升去冲3150，难度有点大。为啥？因为那个“暗流涌动”的快讯和“差5%反转”的提示告诉我们，市场大资金还在犹豫，没形成合力。更大的可能，是行情会再次回踩测试2970这个关键区域。
如果今晚到明天，ETH能在2970-2990这个区域稳稳站住，不再跌破，那这就是一个绝佳的“二次上车”机会。配合MACD金叉，后续积蓄力量再冲3150的概率就大大增加。
反之，如果2970被有效跌破，那短线就要小心了，下一个驿站可能就是2780那个支撑位。到时候，趋势就可能真的转弱了。
